# Dr. Motion

> Dr. Motion specializes in graduated compression socks and hosiery designed for everyday support, athletic performance, and medical wellness across diverse styles and compression levels.

Dr. Motion offers a comprehensive range of compression socks for women, including everyday mild compression, moderate compression, athletic styles, and medical-grade diabetic socks. The brand features licensed Peanuts character designs and provides products in multiple silhouettes from ankle to knee-high.

## Key Topics

- Compression socks
- Graduated compression
- Mild compression (8-15 mmHg)
- Moderate compression (15-20 mmHg)
- Knee-high socks
- Ankle compression socks
- Quarter socks
- Diabetic socks
- Athletic compression
- Women's compression wear
- Peanuts licensed designs
- Circulation support
- Leg health
- Compression tights
- No-show compression
